ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:12 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels; the surface is predominantly low-intensity.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Live calcified barnacle colonies are present at the distal tips of both fluke lobes; extensive circular scarring from previous parasitic colonization is visible across the entire ventral surface.
